Yes.

>That would seem to fly directly in the face of the 'cant play the same
>card twice' rule.

One minion can't play the same action modifier twice on the same action.

Cloak is being played by several other minions, 1 each.

I see that. My concern is, how is that any different from 1 minion
playing the same card multiple times?

So with 4 minions, each could play a cloak on 1 action, giving him +4
stealth, but the acting minion couldn't play cloak himself 4 times.

Isnt this kind of grossly imbalanced towards mass cloak decks (and
other 'non acting minion' play cards)?

T

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>I see that. My concern is, how is that any different from 1 minion
>playing the same card multiple times?
>
>So with 4 minions, each could play a cloak on 1 action, giving him +4
>stealth, but the acting minion couldn't play cloak himself 4 times.
>
>Isnt this kind of grossly imbalanced towards mass cloak decks (and
>other 'non acting minion' play cards)?

Although I used to also think it was unbalanced, it's really not that bad.

First of all, each of the non-acting Cloaking vampires needs to have OBF. So
yeah, 4 minions could contribute +4 stealth to the action, but then you need 4
minions with superior obfuscate. In addition, you're wasting a lot of deck
space with Cloaks. Cloak can be good and all in some cases, but if you have
that much obfuscate, you might as well use Lost in Crowds (+2 stealth) or
Forgotten Labyrinth (+3 if not bleeding). One Forgotten Labyrinth is just as
good as 3 Cloaks. And with all those Cloaks, it might be pretty easy to get
handjammed (esp. if no one blocks your actions).

Halcyan 2
